lines.text: Every County Training session is a step on the pathway. Now, every step is recorded.
lines.caption: Every County Training session is a step on the pathway. Now, every step is recorded.

lines.text: Introducing Performance and Reports in the Suffolk Tennis app: one place where coaches capture how each player is developing, and parents watch it grow.
lines.caption: Introducing Performance & Reports in the Suffolk Tennis app: one place where coaches capture how each player is developing, and parents watch it grow.

lines.text: For coaches, it starts at the register. Open today's session and every player on the programme is right there.
lines.caption: For coaches, it starts at the register. Open today's session and every player on the programme is right there.

lines.text: Tap a player and rate the nine LTA areas, from Confident to Attack to Loves to Compete, with a single tap each. Add a short comment. Last session's ratings sit right beside today's.
lines.caption: Tap a player and rate the nine LTA areas with a single tap each. Add a short comment. Last session's ratings sit right beside today's.

lines.text: When the session ends, every completed report goes to parents automatically. No paperwork. No chasing.
lines.caption: When the session ends, every completed report goes to parents automatically. No paperwork. No chasing.

lines.text: For parents, the report lands in your inbox and in your Parent Hub, under your child's name.
lines.caption: For parents, the report lands in your inbox and in your Parent Hub, under your child's name.

lines.text: Open Performance and Reports to see the latest rating on all nine areas, your coach's comment, and how it compares with last time.
lines.caption: Open Performance & Reports to see the latest rating on all nine areas, your coach's comment, and how it compares with last time.

lines.text: Session by session, the trend lines show where your child is excelling, and what they are working on next. And every report can be shared with your child's own coach, so county and club work to the same plan.
lines.caption: Session by session, the trend lines show where your child is excelling, and what they're working on next. Every report can be shared with your child's own coach, so county and club work to the same plan.

lines.text: One County. One Programme. One Pathway. Suffolk Tennis. Sign in at suffolktennis dot online.
